subject: phase3_provider_free_runtime_refreeze
statement: Freeze the accepted Phase 3 repair into an inactive runtime release and provider-free preparation bundle before considering another scored execution.
selected_option: rebuild every runtime-dependent authority from commit 9f0be43 while retaining prior semantic, dataset, public-environment, evaluator, and resource authority and publishing no live authorization

alternatives.option: edit only runtime-release.json in the retained bundle
alternatives.rejected_reason: The runtime commit is transitively bound by visible input, direct taskpack, preregistration, pilot contract, calibration contract, protocol, and runtime taskpack.

alternatives.option: activate the release for ordinary projects
alternatives.rejected_reason: Experiment preparation does not require or authorize changing project runtime selection.
Provider-free mechanism acceptance and paid benchmark execution are separate decisions.

rationale: The repair commit passed the complete provider-free suite and changed execution semantics embedded in the runtime and experiment protocol. A complete mechanical refreeze is required before a later execution decision can bind the exact tested implementation without mutating historical artifacts.
expected_outcome: An inactive release and digest-bound preparation bundle validate the new controller handoff and candidate policy with zero provider calls and remain incapable of launching a scored run without another decision.
acceptance_refs: bundle replay and Codex config probe
